scope: Only the V18 waiting supervisor may retain an idle CUDA context. Fresh WAIT_P_SENSOR or GPU_OWNER_WAIT state and no unsettled GPU reservations required at every full guard. Actual foreign GPU workers rejected. All original RAM, disk, deadline, optimizer-budget checks retained; >=6GiB free and <=1GiB own reserved. No changes to V18 sources, processes, locks or recipes.
